Hi Jordan — thanks for the metadata. High-level answers and next steps below; Laura and Rishi are looped in for mapping and ops details.

Summary (short):
- SAML: we recommend signed assertions. Audience should be the control plane ACS URL we supply; NameID/email is used for user identity. We accept Okta metadata as-is; we’ll provide SP metadata (ACS, EntityID).
- SCIM: we support SCIM v2 for users and groups. You can provision groups as a top-level resource; we’ll map groups -> Redwood roles via a simple config file on the control plane side.
- Delegated admin: provide a scoped ‘delegated-admin’ role we create in the tenant. It’s revocable and appears in audit logs.

What I need from you to start (action items):
1) Confirm which IdP groups should map to which Redwood roles (e.g., nebula-prod->admin, nebula-readers->viewer). A CSV works.
2) A test Okta service account with provisioning rights (scim_client_test@nebulaai.com).
3) Target cutover window (we prefer a 2-hour window for staged validation).

I’m attaching a short mutual action plan and a sample SCIM mapping file; Laura, can you add the recommended attribute names and the minimal SAML assertion sample?

I can do a 30-min call at 3:00pm PT today or 10:00am PT tomorrow.

Thanks,

Jordan / team — quick technical detail set to accelerate your security review and the cutover: see inline.

SAML specifics (minimal required):
- SP EntityID: https://private-control.redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata (we'll provide tenant-specific URL)
- ACS (POST): https://private-control.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs/<tenant-id>
- NameID: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress (recommended)
- Required attributes: email, firstName, lastName. Optional: groups (array of group names).
- Signing: signed assertions are required for production. Response signing is optional but supported.
- Audience: match the SP EntityID above.

SCIM provisioning (v2):
- Base: https://private-control.redwood-inference.com/scim/v2/<tenant-id>/
- Supported endpoints: /Users, /Groups, /ServiceProviderConfig
- Auth: Bearer token scoped to SCIM provisioning (rotatable).

Example group->role mapping (CSV / simple mapping file):
nebula-admins,redwood:tenant:role:admin
nebula-eng,redwood:tenant:role:engineer
nebula-read,redwood:tenant:role:viewer

Notes on delegated admin model and revocation:
- Delegated admin is a tenant-level role we add to your tenant. Assigning it to a user via SCIM or SAML group is supported.
- Revocation: removing group membership or de-provisioning via SCIM is immediate; actions appear in audit logs.
- We recommend a short-lived access token for SCIM with refresh/rotation policy (30d token rotation suggested).

Security artifacts: we can provide a short runbook and a screenshot pack for your SOC2 evidence: SAML metadata, SCIM audit sample, role assignment logs. Please tell us which evidence items you need.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
